name: optidata-cloud
description: Connect to the hosted Optidata Cloud MCP server: query and provision compute, network, storage, DNS, projects and catalog through the Optidata Cloud public API (/api/v1). Nothing runs locally — the plugin points at the server and authenticates with your portal API key. Resolves resources by name, previews itemized cost before any billable create, and requires two-step confirmation for destructive actions.

ocs_api_key.title: Optidata Cloud API key
ocs_api_key.description: Create it in the Optidata Cloud portal, under your account's API keys. Sent to the server as the x-api-key header. Stored securely on your machine (system keychain), never in a file that syncs to git.
